game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Path, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about picks_right to power up the herbalist and open the mushroom ring.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
